description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the System altar: a tall black stone on a low round dais of grey stone steps, a glowing light blue rune carved in the black stone, three small light blue lights floating above it, a few candles at its foot
